s6607fbc3af8d83: DaoClaud operates two major AI-loaded cloud-native platforms: D.run Compute Resourcees, which provides publicly owned GPU clouds to individual developers and small teams; DaoClaud Enterprise (DCE), which is a private Kubernetes platform for business clients, while carrying training and access.
s9c8761a16a877e: Several challenges have emerged as demand for GPUs from both platforms has grown rapidly:
sadc034769034d5: The whole card allocation causes capacity to be idle.
s87dbbd2d423893: Many references and light loads use only a portion of the GPU resource, but the GPU is usually distributed by whole card, leaving behind a large number of underutilized compute resources and GPU memory, which also limits the design of GPU SKU.
sc40c40b1295725: DaoClaud needs to support both the mainstream NVIDIA GPU and integrated multiple domestic accelerators. The proprietary vGPU program increases licensing costs and makes it difficult for the national production GPU to receive equal support.
s20ab26ed775777: DCE clients want to share GPU pools with sector-level quotas, line-based resource allocation and clear team support.
sf97311fe930a2f: It is important to maintain consistency in the claud-native.
saa33ce89cc7374: DaoClaud's core strategy is centred on Kubernetes and open source technologies. The GPU sharing programme must be fully cloud-native, producer neutral and compatible with existing CNCF tools.

sf3d315af53b46e: DaoClaud uses HAMi as the unified GPU level for D.run and DCE. At the time of case release, HAMi provided CNCF Sandbox projects with equipment for the Heterogeneous accelerator in Kubernetes cluster, virtualization, vGPU cut and scheduling.
sfa02be6d092f11: HAMi is deployed in the production environment of D. Run and DCE, which covers DaoClaud's own GPU and corporate customer-owned GPUs. Together, HAMi has a GPU capacity of more than 10,000 cards distributed across more than 10 data centres in mainland China and Hong Kong. The GPS belongs to different parties depending on the region and the tenant, but Hami provides unified virtualization and scheduling layers for all equipment.
seae49cd198f94e: D. Run company resources: vGPU SKU for common cloud users
s89d003eb454c88: DaoClaud integrates Hami into the D.run regional Kubernetes cluster, achieving fine particle size sharing and higher utilization.
s1ea94abf9ffe01: Splits the physical GPU into multiple slices that clearly define the compute resourcees and GPU memoory. Lightweight use of GPU for a mission, controlled oversubscription further increases overall cluster utilization.
sc03a4ef6adf0de: Places the vGPU slice as a standardized SKU in the unified market, with users choosing by load size without having to pay for the whole card.
se895a2b8465b71: HAMi supports seven active D.run regions in China and Hong Kong, covering more than 10 data centres. Depending on customer deployment and hardware availability, individual areas in production can be expanded to about 3,000 GPU clusters.
s0bbdcc84cd0e09: DaoClaud Extension HAMi support for national production GPU manufacturers, managing NVIDIA and the national production card in a uniform abstraction.

s0d7fb62d7b47a5: On DCE, DaoClaud builds a centralized GPU pool based on Hami to harmonize the capacity of multiple business tenants.
s8877071920b800: Enterprise users contribute to the pool and use GPU, while providing training and access.

Run ' s true experience with DCE, work upstream to improve GPU oversubscription, nodal configuration management and heterogeneous hardware processing, and maintain documentation and deployment guides to help other cloud manufacturers adopt Hami in their production environments.
sde729c9932d6b8: “D.run can manage NVIDIA and GPU on a large scale, seamlessly, through the abstract of HAMi's unified vGPU. Hami has not only increased the use of GPU but also accelerated regional expansion and delivery.”

s981917b68b651f: By integrating Hami, DaoCloud integrates previously fragmented GPU resources into a more integrated, efficient and scalable GPU layer covering both public and private clouds.
s7d33e3e40da2cb: D.run has significantly increased the utilization of GPUs after moving from whole-card distribution to vGPU splitting.
sddbd5debcdc0aa: In DCE, enterprises view GPU as a public resource pool that is subject to quotas and RBAC management. The model streamlines GPU management, enhances transparency and speeds up access to new teams and projects.
sd40e0d0172a91b: Across two platforms, HAMi ' s open structure reduces plant dependence and allows NVIDIA to operate with the national accelerator under unified control.
sbb43fcabc9acc0: “Hami’s relationship with DaoClaud is not just business compatibility, but joint construction. As one of the first contributors to Hami, we have witnessed its evolution from scratch.
